shadows.name: active-range
shadows.purpose: Small lift for the selected range button.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Button state transition only when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 16px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-family:"Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;background:var(--primary);color:var(--surface);border-color:var(--primary)}.ds-primary:hover{background:#1c4939}.ds-primary:active{background:#1c4939}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-primary{transition:background-color .16s ease-out,border-color .16s ease-out}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-secondary{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 16px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-family:"Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)}.ds-secondary:hover{background:#edf5f1;border-color:#91aea0}.ds-secondary:active{background:#ddece4}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Labeled Field
components.description: Persistent label with a readable form boundary.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">账户名称<input class="ds-input" placeholder="例如：我的信用卡 A"></label>
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;font-weight:600;font-family:"Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;font-size:.875rem;color:var(--ink)}.ds-input{display:block;margin-top:5px;min-height:44px;width:100%;min-width:0;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid #a7bbb1;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;caret-color:var(--primary);font-family:"Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}.ds-input:hover{border-color:#91aea0}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Range Navigation
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="报表范围"><button aria-pressed="true">月度</button><button aria-pressed="false">年度</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;background:#eaf1ed;padding:4px;border-radius:9px}.ds-tabs button{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 16px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-family:"Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;min-width:80px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}.ds-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--surface);box-shadow:0 2px 6px #354c5510}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:#edf5f1}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Separate Type Chip
components.description: A separately reported amount that opens its records.
components.css: .ds-chip{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 16px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-family:"Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;font-size:.875rem;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink)}.ds-chip strong{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-chip:hover{background:#edf5f1;border-color:#91aea0}.ds-chip:active{background:#ddece4}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}

components.html:

components.name: Category Row
components.description: Complete category label, amount and share alongside the chart.
components.css: .ds-category{display:grid;grid-template-columns:14px minmax(0,1fr) auto 60px;gap:12px;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);min-height:54px;padding:12px 4px;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;}.ds-swatch{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--mint);border:1px solid #354c5533}.ds-category strong{font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-pct{text-align:right;color:var(--muted);font-size:.875rem}.ds-category:hover{background:#eff6f2}.ds-category:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Transaction Row
components.description: Clickable record with aligned date, description and amount.
components.css: .ds-transaction{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px minmax(0,1fr) 120px;align-items:center;gap:18px;min-height:76px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);width:100%;text-align:left;border-radius:0;background:transparent;padding:14px 4px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;font-family:"Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;}.ds-date{font-size:.875rem}.ds-description{font-weight:550;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-transaction small{display:block;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}.ds-amount{text-align:right;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-transaction:hover{background:#edf5f1;border-color:#91aea0}.ds-transaction:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-transaction{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 110px;gap:8px}.ds-date{grid-column:1/-1}.ds-amount{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;align-self:start}}

narrative.overview:
The personal ledger uses cool paper, dark ink and restrained pastel category marks. Familiar labeled controls and aligned amounts make checking a private record feel calm and direct. Financial values remain the visual subject; the interface supports tracing them to individual records.

This is a form-led, single-owner web application. White containers and fine dividers organize useful density; color identifies categories and interaction without turning the page into a promotional surface. The same standard Chinese sans stack serves headings, labels and numbers, with no external font requests.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper and dark ink with soft category colors.
Direct labeled controls and visible keyboard focus.
Aligned tabular amounts with readable supporting context.
Flat sections, lightly bounded containers and scrollable dialogs.
Desktop paired chart/list and mobile stacked content.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Keep readable labels and amounts in dark ink; use pastel fills for category identity rather than body text.

rules.name: The Local Type Rule
rules.body: Use the installed Chinese sans stack and tabular numerals for amounts; do not fetch external fonts.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal surfaces for ordinary content; reserve structural elevation for modal dialogs and the active range tab.

dos: Do preserve the cool paper, dark ink and confirmed pastel palette.
Do provide explicit labels, visible keyboard focus and at least 44px control targets.
Do keep amounts aligned and use tabular numerals.
Do stack paired content and forms on narrow screens, and let dialogs scroll within the viewport.
Do show missing coverage and source context as readable information.
donts: Don't introduce external font calls or decorative display typography.
Don't use pale category colors for essential text.
Don't replace the direct ledger controls with a marketing hero.
Don't make missing records look like confirmed zero spending.
Don't add heavy shadows, gradients or motion to ordinary ledger sections.
